heroTitle: Automation System Maintenance for DCS & SIS

blocks.alt: Industrial automation maintenance and technical support

blocks.html: Ensuring continuous operation of a plant depends on the control system staying available. One of the most significant threats is a failure inside the control system. A planned maintenance strategy reduces production slowdowns and complete stoppages from DCS, ESD or historian faults.
Preventive maintenance is scheduled and interval-based: maintenance scheduling and implementation against a plan agreed with site personnel.
Maintenance work is targeted and condition-based: improve the efficiency, reliability and service life of your automation systems by acting on measured condition rather than on a calendar alone.

Effective maintenance starts with an audit of systems and devices. Using accurate and up-to-date condition data, we identify the actions required, when and where they apply, and eliminate unnecessary tasks.
System and device assessment supports that audit. On the refinery CHP plant we have maintained DCS, ESD, BMS and MES continuously since 2022, and for eleven years before that from 2007 to 2018.
Maintenance is essential for mitigating control system risk, including corrective work after a failure.

blocks.title: Maintenance on a generating plant is a test programme

blocks.text: Maintenance on a generating plant is a test programme

blocks.html: An inspection round tells you that a system looks healthy. On a generating plant that is not enough, because the functions that matter are the ones that have not run since the last time anybody made them run.
On the hydro plant we maintain, each quarterly visit puts two engineers on site for a week, and the programme includes proving, on the running or shutdown machine as appropriate:

items.html: the emergency shutdown chain, including the shield release command
the shutdown sequences, step by step
overspeed protection
compliance with the governing guarantees, by load rejection
the power controller while synchronised to the grid
the frequency and power controller, by load rejection
the frequency and power controller with the plant transferred to an isolated district
the vibration and shaft runout channels against the protection logic, not merely read

blocks.html: Alongside that, the things that are only discovered by measuring them: battery capacity in the uninterruptible supplies, proved by running them down for at least 30 minutes rather than reading a status lamp; the stored-energy cabinets that close the guide vanes when everything else is gone; failover of the redundant control network and the redundant supply, proved by breaking each; time synchronisation across the system against the GPS reference; and a restore from backup that is actually performed.
Where a failure stops the machine or breaks the exchange of data with the system operator, we are on site within 24 hours of the notification.
Island mode and the testing behind it are covered under Island Mode Operation. The vibration side is under Hydro Vibration and Shaft Monitoring.
